scope: Primary and official sources used for the five Morris County priority town guides

chatham-borough.fact_supported: The municipal website represents Chatham Borough government and publishes current department and public-service contacts.
The borough resource hub links its code, master plan, zoning map, tax map, flood maps, and historic-district guidance.
The assessor maintains borough ownership and assessment records and provides access to current property-record resources.
The borough recreation page identifies municipal facilities including Shepard Kollock Park, Memorial Park, Lum Field, Garden Park, and Stanley Park.
Chatham Station is on Front Street in Chatham, serves the Morris and Essex line, and directs parking questions to Chatham Borough.
The official district website is the source for registration, school contacts, calendars, and attendance information serving the Chathams.
The state publishes School Performance Reports for neutral research into each public school and district.
QuickFacts treats Chatham Borough as its own Census geography, separate from Chatham Township.

chatham-borough.publisher: New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection
chatham-borough.fact_supported: The state flood indicator is a screening resource and says a site-specific assessment is still necessary.

chatham-township.fact_supported: The official municipal website identifies Chatham Township government and its municipal building at 58 Meyersville Road.
The township map library links its zoning map, tax map, watershed map, county GIS, state GIS, and FEMA mapping resources.
The township assessor page is the official starting point for current assessment records and assessment questions.

chatham-township.publisher: Township of Chatham Parks and Recreation
chatham-township.fact_supported: The township recreation page identifies Colony Pool and township facilities including Nash, Shunpike, Esternay, and Mountainview.

chatham-township.publisher: Township of Chatham Open Space Committee
chatham-township.fact_supported: The township publishes open-space plans, inventories, and trail-map documents for current civic research.
The named Chatham rail station is on Front Street and its municipal parking contact is Chatham Borough, not Chatham Township.
The shared district website supplies current registration, school, and attendance information for the two Chatham municipalities.
The state publishes School Performance Reports for neutral school-by-school and district research.
QuickFacts identifies Chatham Township in Morris County as a separate Census geography from Chatham Borough.

chatham-township.publisher: New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection
chatham-township.fact_supported: The state flood indicator is a screening resource and does not replace site-specific flood investigation.

east-hanover.fact_supported: The municipal website is the official directory for East Hanover Township government, departments, notices, and meetings.

east-hanover.publisher: Township of East Hanover Recreation Department
east-hanover.fact_supported: The recreation department publishes current information for township facilities and programs centered at Lurker Park.

east-hanover.publisher: Township of East Hanover Tax Assessor
east-hanover.fact_supported: The assessor page links official property-tax records, tax maps, and county taxation resources.
The township posts adopted ordinances, including measures that may affect land use and zoning requirements.
The official trip planner provides current address-specific transit options, times, transfers, and service alerts.
The district website is the official source for elementary and middle-school registration, contacts, and calendars.

east-hanover.publisher: Hanover Park Regional High School District
east-hanover.fact_supported: The regional district website provides current secondary-school information and registration resources.
The state publishes School Performance Reports for neutral district and school research without third-party scores.
QuickFacts supplies official Census context for East Hanover Township in Morris County.

east-hanover.publisher: New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection
east-hanover.fact_supported: The state flood indicator is a screening resource and advises property-specific investigation.

denville.fact_supported: The official township website publishes Denville government, department, meeting, and public-service information.
The zoning department explains that land use and many property projects require municipal review and current survey information.
The official sale checklist directs sellers to fire-safety inspection requirements and closure of open permits before transfer.
The assessor maintains local tax maps, assessment lists, and real-property valuation records.
The township inventory identifies Cook's Pond, Veterans Memorial Park, Muriel Hepner Park, Gardner Field, and other public spaces.
The municipal trail page provides official trail-system information for trip and access research.
Denville Station is on Estling Lake Road and serves both Morris and Essex and Montclair-Boonton rail lines.
The district website supplies current information for Lakeview, Riverview, and Valleyview schools and registration.
The regional district website provides current secondary-school, registration, and attendance information.
The state publishes School Performance Reports for neutral research into public schools and districts.

denville.publisher: New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection
denville.fact_supported: The state flood indicator is a screening tool and does not replace parcel-specific due diligence.

morris-plains.fact_supported: The official borough website publishes Morris Plains government, department, notice, and meeting resources.
The governing-body page identifies Morris Plains as a borough and explains its municipal government structure.

morris-plains.publisher: Borough of Morris Plains Tax Assessor
morris-plains.fact_supported: The assessor maintains property assessments and records and links the Morris County Board of Taxation.
The borough map library includes zoning, land-use, open-space, trail, street-classification, and development maps.
The borough publishes current zoning-permit requirements for property changes and land-use questions.
The borough explains current inspection and municipal steps connected with residential sales and changes of occupancy.
The official venue directory identifies Watnong Park, Community Park, and borough recreation facilities.
Morris Plains Station is in the Speedwell Avenue and Route 202 area and serves the Morris and Essex line.
The district identifies Mountain Way for prekindergarten through grade two, Borough School for grades three through eight, and a high-school sending relationship.
The receiving district's school overview identifies Morristown High School and current district contacts.
The state publishes School Performance Reports for neutral school and district research.
QuickFacts supplies official Census context for Morris Plains Borough as its own geography.

morris-plains.publisher: New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection
morris-plains.fact_supported: The state flood indicator supports preliminary screening while requiring property-specific investigation.
